description: Expand a record to view the tool request and approval decision, along with the context and execution result at the time.

origin.locateError: Unable to locate the corresponding execution

codeBlock.copyFailed: Copy failed; select the content manually to copy
codeBlock.truncated: Content truncated; the above is the saved excerpt.

modelContext.title: Model review context
modelContext.intro: Below is the snapshot of the input actually sent to the review model for this decision. The background only helps it understand the current action; the verdict follows the review policy.
modelContext.legacyFormat: This record used the legacy input format; the content actually sent at the time is preserved.
modelContext.fromUserMessage: Taken from the current user message.
modelContext.legacyWorkerIntent: This is the legacy Worker intent summary that used to be sent; the new Worker review no longer sends it.
modelContext.noBackground: No background message was attached to this review.
modelContext.noHistorySent: No past calls or execution results were sent for this review.
modelContext.pastCallsHeading: Past calls provided to the model at the time (legacy)
modelContext.noPairedHistory: No paired past tool executions were provided.
modelContext.historyTruncated: History is a limited window; some content is truncated.
modelContext.viewFullJson: View full model review input JSON

alwaysAllow.created: Rule created, the request is still pending approval
alwaysAllow.exists: Rule already exists, the request is still pending approval
alwaysAllow.hint: The prefix does not constrain flags, and it does not cover what the program does next (git hooks, npm scripts, docker images).

detail.noSnapshot: This record has no saved approval detail snapshot, so the context, model initial decision, and execution output at the time cannot be restored.
detail.digestOnly: This legacy record saved only the review input fingerprint, not the input itself, so the context sent to the model at the time cannot be restored. This does not mean the review had no context; newly produced model decisions keep an input snapshot.
detail.noModelInput: This record has no saved model review input; it may have been decided directly by a rule, failed before the model call, or come from an old version.
detail.viewAuditExcerptNotSent: View conversation audit excerpt (not sent to model)
detail.contextExcerptNote: Conversation record excerpt saved at {time}. What the model actually used follows "Model review input".
detail.contextTruncated: Only the most recent context is saved; some content is truncated.
detail.correlationAmbiguous: Concurrent calls with identical arguments exist, so the tool call cannot be uniquely linked; this record does not show a guessed execution result.
detail.correlationNone: No uniquely linkable tool call ID recorded.

table.selectAllAria: Select all pending approvals on this page

errors.loadRecords: Failed to load records: {error}. Click Refresh to retry.
errors.loadPending: Failed to load pending approvals: {error}. Click Refresh to retry.

batch.highRiskNone: None of them is high risk.
batch.confirmBody: Each request is decided on its own; one that cannot be decided stays pending and is listed.
batch.errorsHeading: {count} selected request(s) were not decided and stay pending:
batch.toastPartial: {decided} {verb}, {failed} not decided (see the errors listed above)

empty.title: No approval records
empty.filteredTitle: No approval records match the filters
empty.description: Records will appear here once a rule or model makes an approval decision.
empty.filteredDescription: Adjust the approval status, decision source or deciding actor, or clear the filters to see all records.
